scope: Ink Foundation / Kraken-linked $INK token; facts only

facts.fact: Kraken plans to introduce $INK and Ink L2 to its products; says $INK will be issued by a subsidiary of the independent Ink Foundation, and eligible clients/ecosystem participants were intended for Kraken Drops airdrop; further details to follow as milestones are reached. The article links Ink L2 at inkonchain.com, not directly to @inkfndhq.

Direct status resolves to @inkfndhq, display name INK FOUNDATION; post date 2025-06-17 15:08:50Z. It states $INK total supply permanently capped at 1 billion, with no inflation or future governance minting. X metadata marks profile Business and is_blue_verified=false. This is an account claim, not independent on-chain contract verification.

Current Ink site identifies Ink as an Ethereum Layer 2 built by Kraken; its structured metadata links the Ink network account @inkonchain. This supports Kraken/Ink network identity, not a direct affiliation of @inkfndhq.

FAQ says no information to share regarding any Ink token or airdrop and warns about third-party social posts. No $INK contract or launch date is given. It conflicts with Kraken’s 2025 plan and the June 2025 @inkfndhq supply statement; these sources do not establish whether a token launch occurred.

gaps: No current official token contract address, TGE/launch date, or official trading/listing notice verified in this four-body packet.
Kraken names the Foundation as issuer parent but does not hyperlink that entity to @inkfndhq; handle affiliation is not independently established by its article.
